title: Himalayas
definition: The Himalayas are the world's youngest, highest, and loftiest fold mountain system forming a massive arc stretching over 2,400 km across South Asia, created by the ongoing tectonic collision between the Indian and Eurasian plates.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial core physiographic unit tested in Prelims via longitudinal/latitudinal classifications, pass locations, river origins, and in Mains GS-1 (Geophysical phenomena, geomorphological changes, disaster vulnerability) and GS-3 (Environmental conservation, climate change).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and tectonic mechanisms of Himalayan orogeny.
Evaluate spatial distribution, regional classifications, and transverse river divisions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
